record.name: Andrew Lobb
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Andrew studies geometric and topological spaces, often in low dimensions.

record.name: Anna Felikson
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Anna's current research interests include cluster algebras, Coxeter groups, hyperbolic geometry, and frieze patterns.

record.name: Dirk Schütz
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Dirk's current interests are mostly in knot theory and quantum topology, particularly in Khovanov homology and its generalizations.

record.name: Fernando Galaz-Garcia
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Fernando studies Riemannian and Alexandrov geometry; transformation groups; interactions between curvature, symmetry, and topology; links to data analysis via geometric statistics, topological data analysis, and Wasserstein metrics.

record.name: Jeffrey Giansiracusa
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Jeff studies topological data analysis, phase transitions in QFT, topology and geometry in machine learning and artificial intelligence, tropical algebra and geometry, and non-Archimedean geometry.

record.name: John Bolton
record.title: Retired faculty
record.research: John has retired from active mathematical research, but still teaches undergraduate tutorials organised by the Department of Mathematical Sciences in certain areas of pure mathematics.

record.name: John Hunton
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: John’s research applies methods from homotopy theory and shape theory to the study of aperiodic tilings, and more generally hyperbolic, or chaotic, attractors in topological dynamics. He works on classifications of these spaces and their embeddings.

record.name: John Parker
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: John studies hyperbolic geometry and discrete groups.

record.name: Martin Kerin
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Martin is interested in the geometry and topology of Riemannian manifolds with non-negative sectional curvature, especially in the presence of symmetries.

record.name: Norbert Peyerimhoff
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Norbert's research interests are centered around geometry. Of particular interest are relations between geometry and Laplace- and Schrödinger operators and relations between geometry and dynamical systems.

record.name: Pavel Tumarkin
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Pavel's research mainly concerns the theory of cluster algebras and its interactions with other subjects, in particular hyperbolic geometry and Coxeter groups.

record.name: Raphael Zentner
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Raphael is interested in low-dimensional geometry and topology. One of his main topics is the use of instanton gauge theory to study 3-dimensional manifolds and the representation varieties of their fundamental groups.

record.name: Roan Talbut
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Roan studies the applications of tropical geometry in data science, such as phylogenetic statistics and neural networks.

record.name: Sophy Darwin
record.title: Teaching track
record.research: Sophy is on the teaching track, and lectures on discrete maths, error-correcting codes, and general topology. She likes graph theory, knots, braid groups, and aperiodic tilings, and is involved in several outreach projects.

record.name: Wilhelm Klingenberg
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Wilhelm works in geometric analysis, with specific interests in those problems of differential geometry that can be addressed by methods of complex analysis, convex analysis, and partial differential equations.

record.name: Agata Smoktunowicz
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in noncommutative algebra. You can see my publications on MathSciNet .

record.name: Alexander Shapiro
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in representation theory and Poisson geometry. My work concerns quantum groups, cluster algebra, character varieties, and integrable systems.

record.name: Ana Rita Pires
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I work in symplectic geometry, in particular using hamiltonian actions and moment maps. My work on degenerate symplectic structures — origami manifolds and b-symplectic or log-symplectic manifolds — led me to connections with toric topology, contact geometry, and Poisson geometry. More recently I have become interested in quantitative symplectic geometry by working on symplectic embedding problems. ArXiv

record.name: Antony Maciocia
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: My primary interests are in moduli spaces of objects in the derived category of sheaves on low dimensional algebraic varieties, especially Calabi-Yau varieties and more especially abelian and K3 surfaces. I am also interested in triangulated categories and hyperkahler geometry more generally. I am especially fond of the Fourier-Mukai transform as a means to understand the detailed structure of varieties and their moduli spaces of sheaves. See arxiv for a list of papers.

record.name: Arend Bayer
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I have been working on questions in algebraic geometry motivated by string theory and mirror symmetry; for a while that meant Gromov-Witten theory, in the last few years mostly derived categories and stability conditions. Recently that has led me to very classical questions in algebraic geometry, via wall-crossing and birational geometry of moduli spaces. Google scholar ArXiv

record.name: Ben Davison
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I work on applications of refined and categorified Donaldson-Thomas theory. This includes work in cluster algebras, quantum groups, nonabelian Hodge theory and enumerative geometry of 3-Calabi-Yau varieties and noncommutative varieties.

record.name: Clark Barwick
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in the connections between homotopy theory and arithmetic. In the past this meant thinking about algebraic K-theory. These days, I’m more interested in étale homotopy types and related invariants.

record.name: David Jordan
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I study various algebraic systems which lie between representation theory and physics. More precisely, my research falls roughly into three distinct areas: firstly, I study tensor categories in their various flavors (fusion, braided, symmetric, stable oo-…) – their classification, and their representation theory. Secondly, I study the interplay between non-commutative algebra and algebraic geometry. Finally, I study quantization problems involving quantum groups, quantum orbit spaces, and their geometry. You can find my papers on the ArXiv .

record.name: Dimitra Kosta
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: My research originally lay in the area of birational geometry, yet since then I have been interested in the interplay between algebra, geometry and statistics. My research interests have expanded to include algebraic statistics, phylogenetic algebraic geometry, computational commutative algebra and applied algebraic geometry.

record.name: Iain Grant Gordon
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in Lie theoretic representation theory and its connections with combinatorics, geometry and noncommutative things. You can find my papers on the arXiv , Google Scholar , MathSciNet , or my homepage . Not everything is on the arXiv.

record.name: Ivan Cheltsov
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am birational geometer interested in K-stability and rationality of Fano varieties, subgroups of Cremona groups, polarized cylinders in rational varieties, and relevant classification type problems. You can find my papers here and pictures of my bike here .

record.name: Johan Martens
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I study algebro-geometric and symplectic structures of various moduli spaces, mostly with links to physics (gauge theory, conformal field theory, integrable systems).

record.name: Jon Pridham
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I work on applications of abstract homotopy theory to algebraic geometry. My research has two main strands: derived algebraic geometry, and homotopy theory of algebraic varieties (including arithmetic and motivic aspects). You can find my papers on the arXiv or my homepage .

record.name: Milena Hering
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am working on algebraic geometry, commutative algebra, and combinatorics. My interests include positivity properties of line bundles and syzygies, toric varieties, and tropical varieties. Google scholar ArXiv

record.name: Minhyong Kim
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: My research is mostly in arithmetic geometry, the study of structures that have a combination of arithmetic and geometric natures, Recently, I’ve been mostly interested in the interface between arithmetic geometry and quantum field theory. You can see some of my papers listed on this webpage .

record.name: Nick Sheridan
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I work on homological mirror symmetry and symplectic topology. My papers are available on my webpage .

record.name: Pavel Safronov
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in problems lying at the intersection of representation theory (of quantum groups), algebraic geometry (in particular, derived algebraic and derived symplectic geometry) and mathematical physics (supersymmetric field theories, topological field theories, deformation quantization).

record.name: Sjoerd Beentjes
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in algebraic geometry, in particular the enumerative geometry of Calabi-Yau threefolds, such as (non-commutative) Donaldson-Thomas theory. In recent years, I have become interested in applications of pure mathematics and mathematical statistics to causal questions in population biomedicine and public health policy.

record.name: Sue Sierra
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am a noncommutative ring theorist, specialising in interactions between ring theory and algebraic geometry, particularly the use of geometric techniques to solve problems in algebra. I am particularly interested in birationally commutative algebras (graded algebras that embed in a skew polynomial extension over a commutative ring) and in graded domains of low GK-dimension. Much of my research is motivated by the programme to classify connected graded domains of GK-dimension 3. I am also interested in moduli problems for graded rings and in algebraic geometry, and recently I have begun to work on problems coming from Lie theory, particularly chain conditions in enveloping algebras of infinite-dimensional Lie algebras. My papers are available on my webpage .

record.name: Tom Leinster
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: Most of what I do is about category theory and its many applications, including some nonstandard ones such as geometric measure and aspects of both analysis and theoretical ecology. They are loosely unified by the themes of size and measurement. I am one of the hosts of the n -Category Café , a research blog where I have written about many of my interests. My papers, talks and blog entries can all be found through my home page .

record.name: Tom Lenagan
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: I am interested in noncommutative algebra, in particular in growth of algebras and quantum algebras. I’m also interested in totally nonnegative matrices. Click on my name to reach my webpage where publications are listed.

record.name: Tudor Dimofte
record.title: Academic Faculty
record.research: My research lies at the interface of theoretical physics and pure mathematics, inspired by the dual questions: What algebraic and geometric structures govern the behavior of elementary quantum particles and fields? Conversely, how can physics intuition be used to derive new predictions and results in algebra, geometry, and other branches of mathematics?

record.name: Andrei Negut
record.research: Chair of Representation Theory (CRT) We explore the symmetries underlying a great variety of mathematical objects, of geometric, algebraic, combinatorial or topological origin, as inspired by mathematical physics.

record.name: Dimitri Wyss
record.research: Chair of Arithmetic Geometry (ARG) We study the topology of algebraic varieties through arithmetic methods such as counting points and p-adic/motivic integration. Of particular interest are connections to other fields such as complex geometry, representation theory and theoretical physics.

record.name: Kathryn Hess Bellwald
record.research: Algebraic topology and its applications, primarily to the life sciences, in particular to neuroscience.

record.name: Marc Troyanov
record.research: Troyanov Group (GR-TR) Geometry, differential geometry, geometric analysis, and analysis on metric spaces.

record.name: Nicolas Monod
record.research: Chair of Ergodic and Geometric Group Theory (EGG) Pure Mathematics. Emphasis on Geometry, Group Theory, Analysis, Dynamical systems.

record.name: Zsolt Patakfalvi
record.research: Chair of Algebraic Geometry (CAG) The main focus of the Chair of Algebraic Geometry is the classification theory of higher dimensional algebraic varieties, including exploring its connections to adjacent fields such as commutative algebra, arithmetic geometry and complex geometry.

record.name: Alex Loué
record.research: I am interested in various aspects of discrete groups, with a focus on groups acting on low-dimensional objects. I study properties such as hyperbolicity, Kazhdan’s property (T), and residual finiteness. I am currently investigating finite quotients of 2-dimensional euclidean buildings.

record.name: Andrea Kubin
record.research: My research interests lie in the calculus of variations and geometric measure theory, with a particular focus on Gamma-convergence problems for nonlocal functionals and on variational schemes for geometric flows.

record.name: Arnaud Duvieusart
record.research: I work on new applications of Categorical Galois Theory in Mal’tsev and semi-abelian categories, especially in relation to internal groupoids and crossed modules.

record.name: David Forsman
record.research: My PhD-topic is to develop a non-abelian theory of spectral sequences. Double semi-simplicial groups have certain spectral sequences associated to them. The motivating question is how much can we generalize this to the semi-abelian context.

record.name: Enrico Vitale
record.research: Je participe à la recherche de l’équipe de théorie des catégories. Notre recherche se concentre sur l'algèbre catégorique: plus particulièrement, nous développons certains nouveaux aspects de la théorie des catégories utiles en algèbre homologique non abélienne, algèbre homotopique de dimension supérieur, algèbre universelle et algèbre topologique, théorie de la descente et théorie de Galois, théorie des algèbres de Hopf et des quandle.

record.name: François Cayphas
record.research: I am working on developing a categorical Galois theory for MV-algebras.

record.name: Heiner Olbermann
record.research: Calculus of Variations, Partial Differential Equations, applications in Materials Science

record.name: Jean Van Schaftingen
record.research: I am working in mathematical analysis, on problems in the fields of partial differential equations, calculus of variations and function spaces, including endpoint L¹ estimates for differential operators, Sobolev mappings, Ginzburg-Landau functionals, vortices in fluid dynamics, magnetic Sobolev spaces and semi-linear elliptic problems.

record.name: Laura Constant
record.research: I am currently working on the bicategory of chain complexes of symmetric categorical groups. My first goal is to determine whether this bicategory is 2-abelian. More generally, I am investigating whether the bicategory of chain complexes of an 2-abelian bicategory is itself 2-abelian. Finally, I am studying whether this bicategory admits a model bicategory structure in the sense of Descotte.

record.name: Leon Winter
record.research: I am working on open problems regarding Sobolev mappings (valued in a manifold), in particular on their trace theory. The set of all Sobolev mappings is in general not a vector space and its study is therefore very different from a vector valued Sobolev space. Most of the linear constructions which work wonders in the vector valued case (e.g. by convolution) cannot be used in the manifold valued case.

record.name: Logan Geenis
record.research: My research focuses on square rings and the notion of nilpotency for categories.

record.name: luca descheemaeker
record.research: Module categories for the Soergel category and their diagrammatics

record.name: Lucy Grossman
record.research: Projet principal actuel: une généralisation des théories de prétorsion aux catégories infinies. Autres intérêts de recherche: structures supérieures et fondaments des mathématiques, K-théorie algébrique, physique mathématique.

record.name: Manuel Mancini
record.research: I am Postdoctoral Researcher (Chargé de Recherches Postdoctorant) at the Institut de Recherche en Mathématique et Physique of the Université catholique de Louvain. My research project is entitled “Weak representability of actions of non-associative algebras” and is funded by the Fonds de la Recherche Scientifique – FNRS. Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the Dipartimento di Matematica e Informatica of the Università degli Studi di Palermo from May 2024 to June 2026. I obtained my PhD in Mathematics and Computational Sciences in 2024 at the Università degli Studi di Palermo, Italy, under the supervision of Prof. Giuseppe Metere and Prof. Giovanni Falcone, with a thesis entitled “On the representability of actions of non-associative algebras”.

record.name: Marco Abbadini
record.research: I am interested in the connections between logic, algebra, order and topology that emerged starting with M. H. Stone’s celebrated representation theorem for Boolean algebras in 1936. The main topics of my research are Stone-like dualities and their applications, with a particular focus on MV-algebras and lattice-ordered groups.

record.name: Pedro Vaz

record.name: Robynn Corveleyn

record.name: Rodrigue Haya Enriquez
record.research: I investigate a cosimplicial space retrieving the homotopy type of embedding spaces. The main objective is to compute the rational cohomology of (framed) embedding spaces of small dimensional manifolds into euclidean spaces. Side questions are also on the menu, such as the invariance under change of smooth structure or a generalization to factorization homology.

record.name: Sébastien Mattenet
record.research: Did my masters thesis in topos theory.
